title: Create a Skool activation loop that discovers paid AI pains
purpose: Verify that community growth is tied to member outcomes, pain discovery, and paid backend offers.
prompt: Design a 14-day Skool activation plan for a Polish AI community that should produce paid AI business app opportunities.
expected_behaviors: Defines member promise and paid backend.
Maps YouTube topics into Skool discussions.
Includes onboarding questions and weekly rituals.
Includes monetization guardrails and retention metrics.
failure_patterns: Focuses only on posting more content.
Does not connect to paid offers.
judge_notes: Passing output must include onboarding questions and a pain-mining loop.
